scope: hourly climate trajectory under observed actions

source.citation: Katzin et al. 2020, GreenLight, Biosystems Engineering 194:61-81

minimum_reality_gate.application: must pass pooled holdout and each compartment separately; no parameter refitting or threshold changes after holdout is read

decision_claim_boundary: Passing reproduces the error scale of the original GreenLight validation. The 361 ppm CO2 floor is not by itself decision-grade evidence; counterfactual CO2 claims additionally require policy-ranking robustness across the frozen uncertainty ensemble.
